messages:
docs-olga: Quick doc fix: API ref for GET /v1/models/{model_id}/deployments shows example response with "deploymentId" and 202 status. Live API returns 200 and field is "id". Also examples use header "x-request-id" lowercase.
eng-ben: yup that drifted. Runtime uses 200 for cache/hit path and 202 only for queued async create. Field is "id" now. Header examples should show "Request-Id" casing for readability (server accepts either).
docs-olga: I'll open a small PR to: update example status to 200, change "deploymentId" -> "id", and normalize header to "Request-Id". Will add a short migration note: "Examples previously showed 202/deploymentId; current common response is 200/id; 202 remains for async flows." 
eng-ben: quick curl to confirm:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Request-Id: test-123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/foo-1/deployments
```
# returns 200 + {"id":"dep-...","status":"active"}

sdk-maya: our examples in SDK used "deploymentId" too; i'll queue an examples update after docs PR merges. Can you tag SDK in the PR, olga?
docs-olga: yes tagging @sdk-maya and linking changelog entry. PR small: adjust examples + add migration callout + tests for example schema. ci-bot: docs lint: example response should include schema reference (warning).
pm-sunil: add release-notes link and notify enterprise customers if the timing matters.
docs-olga: will do. merging after one review. Thanks!
